entries.name: Third Coast Comedy Club
entries.summary: Nashville's only brick-and-mortar club built around improv, grown out of LOL Nashville and opened after a 2016 Kickstarter; weekly improv, stand-up and sketch shows plus a training center with six improv levels.
entries.schedule: Seasons Jan-Apr, May-Aug and Sep-Dec with about 150 shows each; Monday open mic
signals: Grew out of LOL Nashville, founded 2013
Six improv levels plus electives and a free Improv Zero workshop
Hosts Third Coast Improv Fest, 10th edition March 18-21, 2027
Raising funds for a new permanent home on Dickerson Pike
entries.reasons: A decade in its own room with the deepest class track in the city and shows most nights, docked a little for a venue move in progress and a site whose schedule pages could not be read.

entries.name: Unscripted
entries.summary: Nonprofit founded 2017 that teaches improv for access: six-week public classes, Improv for Anxiety, Third Beat for older adults, a free weekly Zoomprov jam and a residency with shows and Improv Club at The Barbershop Theater.
entries.schedule: Six-week Saturday class 9:30-11:30am; free weekly Zoomprov jam; Improv Club alternate Mondays 7-9pm
signals: Six-week public improv class on Saturday mornings
Improv for Anxiety and Third Beat (older adults) programmes
Residency at The Barbershop Theater with Verge Theater Company
entries.reasons: Nine years of mission-driven classes and jams with current events, but no venue of its own, few public shows and class pages that do not load a schedule.

entries.name: Nashville Improv
entries.summary: Woman-owned improv company founded 2012 that runs six-week Intro and Intermediate classes in East Nashville and short-form-to-musical shows at Playhouse 615 in Mt. Juliet.
entries.schedule: Shows Fridays 7:30pm at Playhouse 615 ($15); next six-week Intro course starts Oct 13, 2026 ($185)
entries.reasons: Fourteen years and a current class calendar, but only two levels, no room of its own and roughly monthly shows a half-hour out of town.

entries.name: Oddity Improv
entries.summary: Nonprofit clean-comedy troupe and training center founded by Groundlings and Second City alumni, opened in Franklin in 2024; monthly shows at The Franklin Theatre and dates at Zanies Nashville, with one-day workshops and youth classes.
entries.schedule: Second Tuesdays monthly at The Franklin Theatre; Zanies Nashville Nov 3, 2026; levelled core track on hold
signals: Founders from The Groundlings and Second City
Monthly series at The Franklin Theatre
Improv 101 one-day workshops; core track currently on hold
entries.reasons: Two years old with real pedigree and a monthly theatre slot, but its levelled class track is on hold and its workshops show no upcoming dates.
